name: coverdict-vscode
description: Inline coverage gutter, per-line test evidence, and mutation findings, driven by the coverdict CLI.

coverdict.jarPath.description: Path to coverdict.jar. Relative paths resolve against the workspace root. Leave empty to use the default search order (coverdict-cli/target/coverdict.jar, then .coverdict/coverdict.jar).

coverdict.javaExecutable.description: Java executable used to run coverdict.jar.

coverdict.coverageExclusions.description: sonar.coverage.exclusions-style globs (same syntax you'd paste into SonarQube). Passed as --coverage-exclusions to every analyze run - one authored list (D-05), never merged with a repo's own coverdict.config.json.

coverdict.gutter.partialLineMode.description: How a covered-but-not-fully-covered line with no real branch data renders. branch-approximation (default): synthesizes one covered + one missed branch so VS Code shows it as partial (yellow). strict: leaves it branchless, which VS Code renders as fully covered (green).

coverdict.gutter.forceFallback.description: Use the decoration-based fallback renderer even on a host with a working native Test Coverage API. For testing the fallback path (Plan.md F7) without needing an old VS Code build.

scripts.compile: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js
scripts.package: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js --production
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
